# Rylo Labz

> Rylo Labz is an international web design and software company based in Bulawayo, Zimbabwe.
> We build websites that bring in enquiries, and UtahOp, a business management
> system that runs quotes, leads, invoices, stock and jobs in one place.

Contact: wil@rylolabz.com, WhatsApp +263 71 507 9192
Serving: Zimbabwe (Bulawayo, Harare, Gweru, Kwekwe), South Africa, Botswana and the rest of Southern Africa. All work is done remotely.

## What we sell

### Websites
Three packages, each paid once, in US dollars:

- **Base, $150.** Up to 5 pages, enquiry form, WhatsApp and call buttons, works on phones, Google setup, your own domain connected.
- **Premium, $250.** Everything in Base, up to 12 pages, custom design, a booking or quote tool, gallery, enquiries to WhatsApp as well as email, Google Business Profile, visitor stats.
- **E-commerce, $300.** Everything in Premium, product catalogue, cart, checkout, online payments, an orders and stock dashboard, delivery options, team training.

After the build there is one ongoing cost: **$15 a month** for hosting, domain renewal, SSL, weekly backups, security updates, uptime monitoring and up to 30 minutes of small changes a month.

Payment is half up front and half when the site goes live. Ecocash, bank transfer or card.
A working demo appears in 2 weeks. Base goes live in 2 to 3 weeks, Premium in 3 to 4, an online shop in 4 to 6.
The client owns the code and the domain. There is no lock-in and no licence fee.

### UtahOp, a business management system
UtahOp keeps leads and contacts, quotes, invoices and receipts, a point of sale till, products and stock, calendar and bookings, jobs and projects, money and reports, branches and staff in one system. It runs in a web browser and works on a phone.
There is a free clickable demo, no sign up, at https://rylolabz.com/utah
People sign in or create an account at https://yuta-opp.vercel.app/login
UtahOp is priced separately from the website packages, on what the team needs.

### Custom software and automation
Systems built to a business's own rules, plus AI and WhatsApp automation for answering, lead capture and follow-up. Priced per project.
